name: Dirge

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: A mournful 60-foot Emanation surrounds you. Creatures in it other than you and those you spare (your allies) can't regain Hit Points. A creature the Emanation moves onto, entering it, or ending its turn there makes a Constitution save once per turn: on a failure 3d10 Necrotic damage and Prone; on a success half damage and its Speed is halved until the end of its next turn. The Circle casting isn't in the game.
